mapper.select: select * from appr_form f where f.com_id = #{comId} and f.for_status = 1 and f.is_deleted = 0 and f.for_version = ( select max(ff.for_version) from appr_form ff where ff.com_id = f.com_id and ff.for_id = f.for_id and ff.is_deleted = 0 )

select e.emp_id, e.emp_name, p.pos_name, p.pos_order, c.com_id, c.com_name, d.dept_id, d.dept_name from employee e inner join company c on e.com_id = c.com_id inner join department d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id inner join emp_position p on e.pos_id = p.pos_id where e.emp_id = #{empId}
mapper.insert: insert into appr_doc ( emp_id, for_id, for_version, com_id, doc_title, doc_content, is_important ) values ( #{empId}, #{req.forId}, #{req.forVersion}, #{comId}, #{req.docTitle}, #{req.docContent}, #{req.important} )
mapper.select: select count(distinct case when d.emp_id = #{empId} or l.emp_id = #{empId} then d.doc_id end) as "TOTALCNT", count(distinct case when (d.emp_id = #{empId} or l.emp_id = #{empId}) and d.doc_status = 'APP' then d.doc_id end) as "APPCNT", count(distinct case when (d.emp_id = #{empId} or l.emp_id = #{empId}) and d.doc_status = 'REJ' then d.doc_id end) as "REJCNT", count(distinct case when (d.emp_id = #{empId} or l.emp_id = #{empId}) and d.doc_status = 'ING' then d.doc_id end) as "INGCNT", count(distinct case when l.emp_id = #{empId} and d.doc_status = 'ING' and l.lin_status = 'WAI' then d.doc_id end) as "MYCNT", count(distinct case when d.emp_id = #{empId} and d.doc_status = 'ING' then d.doc_id end) as "MYDRAFTINGCNT" from appr_doc d left join appr_line l on d.doc_id = l.doc_id where d.emp_id = #{empId} or l.emp_id = #{empId}

select distinct d.doc_id, d.doc_title, d.emp_id, d.doc_status, d.is_important, d.created_at, (select emp_name from employee where emp_id = d.emp_id) as emp_name, (select lin_status from appr_line where doc_id = d.doc_id and emp_id = #{empId}) as lin_status from appr_doc d where (d.emp_id = #{empId} or exists (select 1 from appr_line where doc_id = d.doc_id and emp_id = #{empId}))
and d.doc_status = #{status}
and ( d.doc_id like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or d.doc_title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or (select emp_name from employee where emp_id = d.emp_id) like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
order by d.created_at desc offset #{pstartno} rows fetch next #{onepagelist} rows only

select d.doc_id, d.doc_title, d.emp_id, d.doc_status, d.is_important, d.created_at, (select emp_name from employee where emp_id = d.emp_id) as emp_name from appr_doc d inner join appr_line l on d.doc_id = l.doc_id where l.emp_id = #{empId} and l.lin_status = 'WAI' and d.doc_status = 'ING'
and ( d.doc_id like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or d.doc_title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or (select emp_name from employee where emp_id = d.emp_id) like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
order by d.created_at desc offset #{pstartno} rows fetch next #{onepagelist} rows only

select count(*) from appr_doc d inner join appr_line l on d.doc_id = l.doc_id where l.emp_id = #{empId} and l.lin_status = 'WAI' and d.doc_status = 'ING'
and ( d.doc_id like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or d.doc_title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or (select emp_name from employee where emp_id = d.emp_id) like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )

select e.emp_id, e.emp_name, p.pos_name from employee e join emp_position p on e.pos_id = p.pos_id where e.dept_id = (select dept_id from employee where emp_id = #{empId}) and e.emp_id != #{empId} order by p.pos_order desc
mapper.update: update appr_doc set doc_status = #{docStatus}, doc_revision = doc_revision + 1 where doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.select: select e.emp_id, e.emp_name, e.emp_status, p.pos_name, p.pos_order from employee e join emp_position p on e.pos_id = p.pos_id where e.dept_id = #{deptId} and e.emp_status != '퇴직' and e.emp_id != #{empId} and p.pos_order > ( select pp.pos_order from employee ee join emp_position pp on ee.pos_id = pp.pos_id where ee.emp_id = #{empId} )

select count(*) from employee e join emp_position p on e.pos_id = p.pos_id where e.dept_id = #{deptId} and e.emp_id != #{empId} and e.emp_status != '퇴직' and p.pos_order > ( select pp.pos_order from employee ee join emp_position pp on ee.pos_id = pp.pos_id where ee.emp_id = #{empId} )

select d.doc_id, d.com_id, d.doc_title, d.doc_content, d.doc_status, d.is_important, d.doc_revision, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.emp_id, f.for_id, f.for_version, f.for_title, f.for_schema, f.for_content, (select emp_name from employee where emp_id = d.emp_id) as emp_name from appr_doc d inner join appr_form f on d.for_id = f.for_id and d.for_version = f.for_version where doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.update: update appr_doc set doc_title = #{req.docTitle}, doc_content = #{req.docContent}, doc_revision = doc_revision + 1 where doc_id = #{docId} and doc_revision = #{req.docRevision}
